# time start denominator

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:timeStartDenominator`](gmeow-timeStartDenominator.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/timeStartDenominator>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The denominator of the rational start position of a [`MusicalTimeSpan`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeSpan.md) in its frame. Always positive.

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:MusicalTimeSpan`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeSpan.md) -> [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer); functional
